propositions: managed_refs marks a link managed upon local creation but cannot distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted links
inbound removal records for never-pushed managed links can be incorrectly applied when vendor type collides with existing remote links in opposite direction
the system must persist peer-confirmation records keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) to discriminate peer-confirmed from never-pushed links
inbound removal of a never-peer-confirmed link must be declined and logged, while removals of peer-confirmed links continue to converge
peer-confirmation records must survive snapshot compaction via sidecar storage and be populated from authoritative fetched snapshots with completeness signals
existing managed links must be backfilled as confirmed-at-upgrade to prevent the first post-upgrade pass from declining legitimate removals
